summary: Join our Global Compliance Standards and Regulations Training to master essential compliance skills and navigate complex regulatory landscapes effectively.
lede: Global compliance training is intended for professionals overseeing compliance, risk, legal, audit, governance, procurement or financial functions. It covers interpreting international frameworks, aligning internal policies and procedures, assessing risk exposure, and establishing and monitoring a compliance management system, with practical topics including ethical conduct, data privacy, supply-chain controls, financial operations and compliance audits.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, monitor, or enforce compliance within organizations. It caters to those who are on the front lines of ensuring that their organizations not only meet but exceed global compliance standards.
audience: Financial Controllers and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Officers
NGO and Public Sector Policy Advisors
modules: Compliance in Supply Chains and Procurement
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of compliance principles and experience in a related field. Familiarity with key compliance regulations and standards is recommended but not required.
